about: Deliberately empty. This is not a gap waiting to be filled in.
SAVE DATA ON THIS PLATFORM IS SIGNED FOR THE CONSOLE THAT WROTE IT. A save downloaded
from anywhere else is not a save you can use - it is a file the target rejects. A list
of downloadable saves would therefore be a list of things that do not work, and every
entry in it would look exactly like an entry that does.
It is also somebody's own data. Everything else listed here was published on purpose by
the people who made it; nobody publishes a save for strangers to install.
WHAT THIS SECTION IS FOR: your own saves, copied off your own target and back onto it.
That works, needs no list, and is what the local and remote panes do.
The file exists so the format is documented and so the section can say why it is empty
instead of looking broken. Adding entries is supported - the machinery does not care what
it is moving - but nothing shipped will fill it in.
The format is docs/manifest.schema.json - the same one payloads use.
